notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
Fix quest launch problem & minor bug fixes

Fixed an issue preventing certain quests from starting correctly.

Various minor bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: First Steam Release is Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to launch the first Steam version of the game! 



We’re excited to bring you the official and complete version of the game.

Thank you for your support and feedback — your ideas will help shape upcoming improvements and new content.


🙏 Huge thanks to our community for your support and for joining us !

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/255b0c0b56f33253584f31b6339f6ce25af3b272.png"]

notes.title: Update #826
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/1665476d92538af26a60f79e4a539aa48e26f6c4.png  
Hello,  
We are thrilled to present the latest improvements and major additions to the game, designed to enrich your experience and enhance player interactions.  
Here’s an overview of the new features now available:  

Corporation:  
Create and Manage a Corporation (Guild): You can now establish your own corporation, recruit members, and collaborate to achieve common goals.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/31c55d52238273bd206516f3a495bc6a552db505.png  
Co-op Mode with Leaderboard (Contribution): A brand-new way to play and cooperate with other players!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/d40af5f9e1bb01fe7d67118845236f8de7e88fe6.png  
Fight Bosses with Rankings  

Space Port Contracts:  
Discover an exciting new economic feature with the Space Port.  
You can accept inter-corporation contracts, assign your units to complete them, and earn valuable resources while fulfilling your commitments.  
The more contracts you complete, the higher your reputation will grow.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/d055a6d5b5cab16672854f00ce03085536c4dd93.png  

These additions aim to strengthen the community and strategic aspects of the game.  

An "open" test version is available on the Android Playstore. Feel free to try it and share your feedback/bugs!  
The Steam version is progressing well and should be ready for testing at the beginning of Q1.  

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New beta version '702'
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/27da42ce43ab080bdddda4dc569a7a54ec7adbaa.png
Introducing the new beta version '702,' which brings significant enhancements to both the user interface and the core mechanics of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/1cde4daf4bf5d3619ae8bc8535de093476a98943.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/b36ec6433b20d10c621255760091c599039f5819.jpg

In addition to the UI overhaul, beta version '702' introduces a major upgrade to the PVP combat system. The old pathfinder system has been replaced with the Unity NavMesh Agent, offering a more sophisticated and responsive navigation system. This change results in smoother, more realistic movements and interactions during player-versus-player combat, enhancing both strategy and gameplay fluidity.

Thanks,

[previewyoutube=4XC1btwjCyw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
